subject.title: feat(ui): complete Control UI MCP App bridge

question: Should a host-confirmed MCP App message ever be allowed to invoke `!` command syntax, or must MCP App requests be restricted to non-command plain chat text?
rationale: This is a user-authority and command-routing policy choice at the sandbox-to-chat boundary; the code should fail closed until the owning direction is explicit.

options.title: Restrict to conversational text
options.body: Reject both slash and bang command prefixes before confirmation and dispatch, preserving a text-only MCP App bridge.

options.title: Permit bang commands deliberately
options.body: Document the intended authority transfer, define confirmation semantics for command-capable requests, and add focused security coverage before merge.

recommendation.title: Restrict to conversational text
recommendation.body: Reject both slash and bang command prefixes before confirmation and dispatch, preserving a text-only MCP App bridge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and are assigned to the current bridge implementation, making them the available routing contact for the required design clarification.
